exposure: progestin-only contraceptives (including progestin intrauterine devices, progestin-only oral contraceptives, progestin injections, progestin implants)
duration of exposure to different types of progestin-only contraceptives
timing of progestin-only contraceptive dispense after delivery
outcome: persistent pelvic girdle pain 18 months after delivery
cohort: 20,493 women from the Norwegian Mother and Child Cohort Study who reported pelvic girdle pain in pregnancy week 30.
finding: Progestin intrauterine devices and progestin-only oral contraceptives were associated with a small beneficial effect on recovery from pelvic girdle pain, while progestin injections and/or implants might be associated with modestly increased odds of persistent pelvic girdle pain.
